title: The agent works
say: A scripted agent calls tools through the gateway with a short-lived token.

title: A cap or an operator steps in
say: A rate or cost cap trips by itself, or an operator pulls the switch.

title: Access is revoked
say: The token is revoked and the token service stops issuing new ones.

title: The next call fails
say: The very next call is refused. Anything already in flight is a separate question.
